scientific_target: Determine whether the unresolved two-lowest-singlet pair of C5H5+ is nevertheless an isolated, reproducible rank-2 electronic manifold on the already computed central loop.

antecedents.relaxed_multiring_required_failure: The 20/40/80 central-loop meshes pass all electronic, external-isolation, pair-subspace, active-space, and geometry checks but fail only the unchanged 2e-4 Eh internal adiabatic-gap gate.
antecedents.central_gap_screen_required_result: Neither the cone_v1 nor smooth_quadratic sampled spoke reaches the unchanged 2e-4 Eh internal-gap target and the antecedent anchors reproduce within the frozen tolerance.

locked_model.rank2_object: P12, the projector onto the two lowest singlets

projector_mesh.surface: the immutable antecedent cone_v1 relaxed Fourier surface
projector_mesh.point_requirements: Recompute the antecedent production checks, including the CASCI third-singlet isolation probe, from each hash-frozen SA2 checkpoint.
projector_mesh.edge_requirements: Use exact determinant overlap matrices and gate only rank-2 pair and active-orbital subspace singular values/leakage.

SA3_symmetry_wedge.symmetry_reduction: On the 40-point ring, C5 rotations reduce indices modulo 8 and reflection maps residue j to 8-j; residues 0 through 4 are the five inequivalent classes.
SA3_symmetry_wedge.calculation: five fresh, independently initialized, equal-weight SA3-CASSCF(4e,5o) calculations
SA3_symmetry_wedge.comparison: exact determinant overlap of each existing SA2 pair with the lower-two subspace and third root of the matching SA3 solution
SA3_symmetry_wedge.purpose: test electronic rank and third-state isolation independently of the SA2 optimizer

nonabelian_transport.edge_overlap: M_k with elements <Psi_a(R_k)|Psi_b(R_k+1)> from exact complete-CASSCF determinant overlaps
nonabelian_transport.edge_transport: the unitary polar factor U_k of M_k
nonabelian_transport.gauge_covariance: under independent corner gauges G_k in U(2), W transforms by similarity G_0^dagger W G_0
nonabelian_transport.orientation_control: recompute all exact overlaps on the independently traversed reverse polygon and compare its invariants with the conjugate forward invariants
nonabelian_transport.cyclic_start_control: evaluate every cyclic starting edge and compare similarity invariants
nonabelian_transport.mesh_control: compare the 40- and 80-point invariant spectra using an unordered wrapped-eigenphase metric plus trace and determinant differences

interpretive_limits: A pass establishes a smoothly transportable and externally isolated rank-2 manifold under the frozen model and path.
A pass does not resolve either individual adiabatic root where E2-E1 is below the frozen scalar threshold.
The rank-2 Wilson spectrum is a manifold-holonomy diagnostic and cannot by itself count conical intersections internal to P12.
No scalar Berry sign, secondary-CI parity, or absolute-ground-state claim is authorized.

decision_statuses.PASS_RANK2_PROJECTOR_AUTHORIZATION: Both phase-blind antecedents and all reused checkpoints are intact and authorize only the rank-2 calculation.
decision_statuses.STOP_RANK2_PROJECTOR_AUTHORIZATION_FAILU: The source, provenance, phase embargo, or internal-gap-only diagnosis changed.
decision_statuses.STOP_SA3_WEDGE_ARBITRATION_FAILURE: At least one independent SA3 symmetry class fails to preserve an isolated lower-two-state projector.
decision_statuses.STOP_PROJECTOR_POINT_QUALITY_FAILURE: At least one reused SA2 vertex fails its frozen electronic or third-state-isolation checks.
decision_statuses.STOP_PROJECTOR_EDGE_FIDELITY_FAILURE: At least one pair-projector or active-space edge fails its frozen fidelity thresholds.
decision_statuses.STOP_PROJECTOR_INVARIANCE_FAILURE: A random U(2) gauge, reverse-orientation, or cyclic-start invariant fails numerical closure.
decision_statuses.REFINE_RANK2_PROJECTOR_MESH: The manifold passes local controls but the 40/80 Wilson spectra do not meet the preregistered discretization tolerance.
decision_statuses.PASS_RANK2_PROJECTOR_QUALIFICATION: The rank-2 manifold passes independent SA3, external-isolation, edge-fidelity, invariance, and mesh-convergence controls.

publication_policy.required_after_pass: an independently seeded opposed-history replication of the five SA3 wedge calculations and rank-2 spectra
forbidden_post_hoc_changes: lowering the original 2e-4 Eh scalar internal-gap threshold
exposing or multiplying signed one-state overlaps
using individual-root assignment as a rank-2 pass gate
changing the cone surface, radius, 20/40/80 meshes, active space, basis, or electronic rank after seeing the Wilson spectrum
interpreting a rank-2 Wilson spectrum as a count of conical intersections internal to the two-state manifold
